metadata.title: Subscrip | Subscription Management
metadata.description: Control your recurring expenses and avoid surprises.

hero.title:
Manage subscriptions,
income, and monthly spending in one place.
hero.description: Get a complete view of your recurring finances with smart alerts and real-time monthly tracking.

metrics.controlMessage: Centralize everything in one dashboard and track each subscription without losing money on forgotten charges.

subscriptionsPage.title: Subscriptions
subscriptionsPage.subtitle: Manage your recurring subscriptions.
subscriptionsPage.empty: No subscriptions yet. Add one to get started.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.subtitle: Manage your account profile and default preferences.

form.title: Account settings
form.description: These preferences are used as defaults across Subscrip.
form.name: Name
form.emailDescription: Email changes are not available in this version.
form.defaultReminderDaysDescription: How many days before a renewal Subscrip should remind you by default.
form.quickReminderDays: {days, plural, =0 {Same day} one {# day} other {# days}}
form.error: Could not save settings. Try again.

currency.BRL: Use BRL as your default for new records.
currency.USD: Useful when most services are billed in dollars.
currency.EUR: Use EUR as your default currency.

reminderChannel.PUSH: Use app push notifications when available.
reminderChannel.BOTH: Use both channels for important renewals.

darkThemeVariant.title: Dark theme
darkThemeVariant.description: Choose the appearance used when dark mode is active.
darkThemeVariant.modalDescription: Choose between the current blue dark theme or a darker version with black tones.
darkThemeVariant.error: Could not update the dark theme.

BLUE.label: Dark blue
BLUE.description: Keeps the current look with a dark blue background and emerald accents.

BLACK.label: Deep black
BLACK.description: Uses a darker base with black tones and stronger contrast.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.description: Manage cards and payment methods used by subscriptions and planned expenses.

tooltips.type: Defines whether this method is used as a card, PIX, boleto, cash, or another payment type.
tooltips.cardNickname: Short name used to identify this card in lists and invoices.
tooltips.last4: Used only to visually recognize the card. Do not enter the full card number.
tooltips.closingDay: Day of the month when the card invoice closes.
tooltips.dueDay: Day of the month used to calculate the invoice due date.

financePlannerPage.title: Finance Planner
financePlannerPage.subtitle: Monthly record of income, bills, subscriptions, and card expenses.

form.name: Name
form.validation: Name and a positive amount are required.
form.installmentValidation: Current installment and total installments are required.
form.recurrenceValidation: Enter a valid number of months for the recurrence.

planning.description: Switch between income, expenses, and card costs while keeping the selected month context.

modal.incomeDescription: Add or edit income expected for the selected month.
modal.expenseDescription: Add or edit monthly expenses outside credit card purchases.
modal.cardCostDescription: Add or edit credit card purchases for the selected month.

tooltips.purchaseDate: Date when the purchase happened. Future installments will follow this month.
tooltips.dueDate: Date when this cost should be paid or appear in the monthly plan.
tooltips.expensePurchaseDate: Date when the expense was contracted or purchased.
tooltips.expenseDueDate: Date when this expense is due.
tooltips.installmentNumber: The installment you are adding now. Example: 3 if this is the 3rd payment.
tooltips.installmentTotal: Total number of installments. Example: 12 for a 12-month loan.
tooltips.incomeExpectedDate: Expected date to receive this income. Future recurrences use this month as reference.
tooltips.incomeRecurrenceMonths: Total number of months this income should be created for, including the current month.

income.empty: No income registered for this month.
income.isMonthlyRecurring: Repeat monthly for the next 12 months
income.isFixedRecurring: I will receive this amount for a fixed number of months

expense.empty: No expense registered for this month.
expense.isMonthlyRecurring: Repeat monthly for the next 12 months

cards.title: Cards - monthly detail
cards.empty: No card expense for the selected period.
cards.syncHint: Purchases added here are saved as credit card expenses and appear automatically in the monthly planner.
cards.noCards: Create a credit card payment method in settings before adding card purchases.
cards.emptyPurchases: No purchase added to this card this month.

deleteDialog.title: Delete recurring item?
deleteDialog.singleDescription: This will remove only this item.
deleteDialog.recurringDescription: This item belongs to an installment or recurring group. Choose how much you want to remove.

editScopeDialog.title: Apply edit to which items?
editScopeDialog.description: This item belongs to an installment or recurring sequence. Choose whether this change applies only to this record or to this and future records.
editScopeDialog.singleDescription: Keeps future installments or recurring records unchanged.
editScopeDialog.futureDescription: Applies the new values to this month and future months in the same group.

cardInvoicePage.title: Card Invoice
cardInvoicePage.subtitle: Track card purchases and the consolidated invoice for the month.
cardInvoicePage.description: Review card items for the selected month. The consolidated invoice still appears as an expense in the Finance Planner.
